$comment: Current, source-backed catalog of implemented Muster behavior. Screenshot capture scaffolding and unsupported reconstruction claims are intentionally excluded.

app.name: Muster
app.description: A local workspace for repositories, worktrees, changes, review notes, agent sessions, and terminals.

not_shipped.reason: No Windows release target is configured.

features.name: Repositories and worktrees in one workspace
features.description: Browse registered repositories and their checkouts in a sidebar, select the active checkout, and see change counts alongside it.
details: Create a worktree from the repository actions menu by choosing its branch and location.
Removing a worktree is guarded by an explicit confirmation.

features.name: Browse and edit checkout files
features.description: Navigate a checkout's file tree, open source files in the document pane, edit them, and save changes to disk.
details: Source files receive automatic language detection and syntax highlighting; the language can also be selected manually.
Sticky folder rows can keep parent directories visible while scrolling.

features.name: Inspect working-tree changes
features.description: See changed files with added and removed line counts, open individual diffs or a combined change set, and follow repository changes as they update.

features.name: Line-anchored review notes
features.description: Attach notes to lines in a diff. Notes have sent, resolved, or outdated states; outdated anchors can be reviewed and accepted, and notes can be edited or deleted.

features.name: Send review rounds to OpenCode or export Markdown
features.description: Collect open review notes into a review round, choose an OpenCode session, and send or queue the round; Markdown export is available for other tools.
details: The UI reports unfinished rounds and can include outdated notes in a send or export.
OpenCode delivery is handled through Muster review-round dispatch and reconciliation, not by directly exposing the low-level agent prompt command.

features.name: OpenCode session sidebar
features.description: Connect to a locally running OpenCode service, create or select sessions, and show session activity alongside checkouts.
details: The user must start the OpenCode service; Muster connects to its API v2 and does not launch it.
Associations between sessions and terminals are inferred from terminal titles, not from an explicit session identifier in the shell.

features.name: Multiple terminals per checkout
features.description: Open shell sessions in the selected checkout, interact with terminal output, and optionally follow worktree changes caused by shell navigation or OpenCode activity.
details: Terminal preferences include font, ligatures, cursor, scrollbar, shell integration, and worktree-following mode.
Terminal processes are runtime state and are not restored as running sessions after application restart.

features.name: Rendered Markdown documents
features.description: Preview Markdown with tables, task lists, fenced code highlighting, front-matter metadata, and checkout-relative images.
details: Raw HTML is disabled; links and local image paths are restricted, and rendered output is sanitized.
Remote images and paths that escape the checkout are not loaded as preview images.

features.name: Resizable, focused workspace layout
features.description: Resize the navigation, main document, and inspector panes, and use the available split or focused layout modes.

features.name: Interface, terminal, and editor preferences
features.description: Configure appearance, scale, typography, terminal behavior, and editor indentation. Preferences are stored in ~/.muster/config.yml.

features.name: Local workspace and review persistence
features.description: Store workspace, checkout UI state, and review data locally; restore the workspace on launch. Settings are kept separately in the local configuration file.
details: The SQLite schema has a strict version check and no migration ladder; a database with an unknown schema version is refused.
Terminal processes and terminal session layouts are cleared at startup.

runtime_notes.behavior: A local OpenCode service must already be running; Muster connects to it and does not start it.
Workspace and persisted UI/review state are restored, but running terminal processes are not.
Do not describe moved/missing-checkout relocation as a shipped UI feature: locate_missing_checkout is backend-only.

backend_only.name: git_viewed_files / git_mark_viewed
backend_only.note: Registered backend commands; not exposed as current UI actions.

backend_only.name: locate_missing_checkout
backend_only.note: Backend command only; do not claim the UI automatically relocates or reattaches a moved checkout.

backend_only.name: agent_prompt / agent_stop
backend_only.note: Direct backend commands, not current UI controls; review delivery uses the review-round flow.

catalog_notes: This catalog describes the current v0.20.0 implementation, not plans or commands that have no UI entry point.
Tests were inspected during the code audit but are not reported as run.
